grammar_focus: 综合复习(主考:一般将来时 will · 过去完成时 had done · 间接引语 said/told + 从句将来变 would · if 条件句 if + 现在时/主句 will · must 推测 & had to 过去 · can/may 请求与 could 过去 · 被动语态 be + 过去分词)+ there is / there are 存在句(辅考)
scene: 收到远在尼日利亚的姐姐来信,说明年要来;她若来准会大吃一惊——我们已搬进乡间一栋崭新的现代化住宅,五个月前竣工,是全区唯一的现代房,在有些人看来还挺古怪

grammar_card.title: 综合复习:把学过的时态和句型串起来
grammar_card.intro: 本课不学新语法,而是把前面几课的关键句型复习一遍——将来时、过去完成时、间接引语、if 条件句、must / have to、can / may、被动语态。全用本课句子举例。

rows: 一般将来时 will + 动词原形
If she comes, she will get a surprise.
过去完成时 had + 过去分词('过去的过去')
Work on it had begun before my sister left.
间接引语:主句过去,从句 will 变 would
She said that she would come to America.
被动语态 be + 过去分词
The house was completed five months ago.

specialRules.rule: if 条件句:if 那半句用一般现在时,主句用 will(If she comes, she will…)
存在句:There is + 单数 / There are + 复数(There is a lovely garden)

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why is the new house special?
options: It is very modern, maybe the only modern house in the district

passage: I had a letter from my sister yesterday. She lives in Nigeria. In her letter, she said that she would come to America next year. If she comes, she will get a surprise. We are now living in a beautiful new house in the country. Work on it had begun before my sister left. The house was completed five months ago. In my letter, I told her that she could stay with us. The house has many large rooms, and there is a lovely garden. It is a very modern house, so it looks strange to some people. It must be the only modern house in the district.

stage5.stem: "明年将要来"用一般将来时,怎么构成?
"If she comes, she ___ get a surprise."(主句用一般将来时)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果她来,她会大吃一惊。

stage5.stem: "在姐姐离开之前就已动工"用哪个时态?
options: 过去完成时(had + 过去分词)

stage5.stem: "Work on it ___ begun before my sister left."(过去完成:早已开始)
stage5.stem_cn: 在我姐姐离开之前,建设就已开始了。

stage5.stem: 间接引语里,主句是过去时,从句里的将来 will 要变成:
"She said that she ___ come to America."(间接引语:将来要变)
"告诉某人某事"用 say 还是 tell?
if 条件句(讲将来),if 那半句用什么时态?
"If she ___, she will get a surprise."(if 那半句用现在时)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果她来了,她会感到意外。

stage5.stem: "If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay home."(if 那半句用现在时)
stage5.stem_cn: 如果明天下雨,我们就待在家里。

stage5.stem: "It ___ be the only modern house here."(有把握的推测:一定是)
stage5.stem_cn: 这一定是这里唯一的现代化住宅。

stage5.stem: "昨天我不得不加班"里,过去的"必须"用哪个词?
"I told her that she ___ stay with us."(过去语境:可以/能)
stage5.stem_cn: 我告诉她她可以和我们住在一起。

stage5.stem: 委婉地请求"我可以进来吗",用:
"The house ___ completed five months ago."(过去被动:被完工)
被动语态(be + 过去分词)表示:
options: 主语是动作的承受者(被…)

stage5.stem: "___ a lovely garden behind the house."(存在句:有一个花园)
stage5.stem_cn: 房子后面有一个漂亮的花园。

stage5.stem: "There ___ many large rooms in the house."(存在句:有许多房间,复数)
